meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Write or revise document
node.instructions: Read document.path, document.template, document.inputs, document.contract, and document.content_language from the supplied blackboard and node references. Write or revise the target document immediately. Preserve valid frontmatter and do not read the runtime XML directly.
node.acceptance: The target document exists, follows its authoring contract, and has complete YAML frontmatter.

node.title: Validate draft document
node.instructions: Run xc-document validation for document.path and document.kind.
node.deliverables: A validation result recorded in the node result.
node.acceptance: xc-document validates the draft without errors.

node.title: Review document
node.instructions: Review document.path against the domain review dimensions. Write findings to the declared node artifact and set document.review.open_issues to true or false through the runtime.
node.deliverables: A review artifact with prioritized findings and closure criteria.
node.acceptance: The review distinguishes required findings from optional observations and sets document.review.open_issues.

node.title: Revise document from review
node.instructions: Read the latest review artifact and revise only document.path. Preserve document.content_language when it is set, preserve valid frontmatter, and record the updated document as the node artifact.
node.acceptance: Required review findings are resolved or explicitly escalated to a user gate.

node.title: Confirm document decisions
node.instructions: Present the document-specific decisions to the user. Record short choices in the blackboard and create revision nodes when feedback changes the document.
node.deliverables: Structured user decisions or an explicit continuation decision.
node.acceptance: Required user decisions are recorded and any necessary revision nodes are scheduled.

node.title: Validate final document
node.instructions: Run xc-document validation for document.path and document.kind after review and user decisions.
node.deliverables: A final validation result recorded in the node result.
node.acceptance: xc-document validates the final document without errors.
